name: OASIS
tagline: Open social simulations with one million agents.
description: A scalable, open framework for studying how information, norms, polarization, and collective behavior emerge in large populations of language-model agents.

name: SPAgent
tagline: A foundation agent for the physical and spatial world.
description: A general-purpose multimodal tool-calling framework that connects vision-language models to an open-ended ecosystem of perception, grounding, 3D, and generation tools.

name: CoMAS
tagline: Agents that co-evolve through interaction rewards.
description: Agents interact, evaluate one another, and optimize from self-produced reward signals—turning social interaction into an open-ended curriculum.

name: Think3D
tagline: Thinking with space, not only about it.
description: Interactive 3D chain-of-thought combines reconstruction, view switching, and camera manipulation so agents can actively explore spatial problems.

name: MA-VLA
description: A vision-language-action model that decomposes cooperative behavior into atomic prompts, assigns roles, and recomposes skills for unseen collaboration patterns.
